## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Sant Antoni de Portmany, Spain. It starts at Km 7.5 Carretera Eivissa-Sant Antoni.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Multiple studies have shown that engaging with plants has a positive impact on humans, both from a psychological and emotional perspective. Visit this new multifunctional space in Ibiza, a place to observe, learn, relax, and enjoy the nature of Ibiza and Formentera through Biotechnology. Take a guided tour and learn how science and technology are helping us achieve our goals to ensure a better future for the environment.
>
> Visit the world’s first “piano” to be made from living plants. You can literally watch plants activate electronic systems with a human touch and produce a show of lights and music! A symbiosis between nature and technology – is this the way to a greener future?

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €21.38. It was rated 4.2 out of 5 from 2 ratings and 1 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
